verdict.rationale: No documented bulk or batch operation appears in the evidence. SES offers programmatic sending through the API, SDKs and SMTP, plus templated messages with per-recipient tag substitution. Verifying a domain identity also covers every address under it at once, and community users report running mailing-list and mass sends through SES, though list management comes from external tools. Missing for 10: a documented bulk/batch send API, bulk management of identities, templates or suppression lists, batch limits and partial-failure semantics, and hands-on evidence of bulk operations driven by an agent.
